physical_scope.source_event_core_join: exact original source core ID, no coordinate or pseudo-matched site aliases

fixed_sampling_rule: For each of 29 exact author (island, locationID) sites present in B1,B2,B3 and separately for each of two exact original samplingProtocol methods, count original source Event rows in each period.

Let k be MINIMUM of the three period Event sample counts within that exact same site and protocol; require k>=1 for each original site/method. Use k source original Event primary IDs in each period chosen by original core ID lexicographic sort (not species/abundance, no outcome access).

Author source Event ID values, including trap positions, may not correspond perfectly between periods; equal original Event counts approximate rather than guarantee equal biological detectability. Never infer temporal species arrivals/extinctions from mere absence.
All 29 sites × 2 methods × 3 periods are retained. 10379 original Event rows remain publisher denominator; only selected matched sample subset goes to biological v1.314.
Use source 7 original island abbreviations to match, with 198 Graciosa out-of-phase Event rows excluded. No new unverified islands.
future_species_question: At exactly matched 29 seven-island native-forest transects and equal Event counts per phase/method, quantify 20-year site-level taxonomic replacement versus stable richness separately for Araneae and Coleoptera and endemic/native versus introduced source origin where taxonomy supports.
